named_collations.evidence: In wandaraya, 871 ICU and 2 libc named collations have recorded/actual version differences. Their dependencies and application use require documented review; no refresh was executed.

cross_dataset_constraint.evidence: Separate foreign keys do not by themselves enforce that a grid and observation or checkpoint belong to the same dataset; the executor checks grid ownership. A production execution path must retain and test that check.

The lower-level import_sample accepts an engine and is not itself a production authorization gate.
